role: GPX 1.1 writer for workout sessions (metadata name/desc/time, one trk/trkseg of trkpts with ele/time) and the decoder that rebuilds [CLLocation] from the stored two-part Google polyline (coords + decimetre altitudes) with evenly spread synthetic timestamps; decode is used app-wide (exports, route matching, HealthKit route export, TRIMP backfill, AI facts). Also reads the fix times a workout stored beside its polyline (gpsFixTimes) and puts a decoded track back at them for the exports.
types: GPXExporter: enum — GPX writer + polyline decoder
state: file:tmp/Exports/<sport.rawValue>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss UTC>.gpx (writeToTempFile; pendingFile only builds it in memory)

units.does: Builds a GPX 1.1 document: header with sport/start/summary desc (which says whether point times are recorded or spread evenly), one trkpt per fix — at its recorded time when the workout stored them (timedAsRecorded) — and closing tags.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite SharedUserDefaults.appGroup; legacy UserDefaults.standard fallback, migrated on read)

branches.cond: recorded fix times match the track
branches.effect: desc says the times are recorded; else that they are spread evenly

units.does: Builds the human-readable <desc>: preferred unit system, the recorded totals from summaryTotals (left out when none), that the payload is metric, and the point-times note (pointTimesNote: recorded fix times, or spread evenly so pauses don't show as stops).
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite SharedUserDefaults.appGroup; legacy UserDefaults.standard fallback, migrated on read)

units.does: The sentence an export writes about its point times, naming the points with `points`: that they are the times the GPS fixes were taken, or (not recorded) that they are spread evenly across the session so pauses don't appear as stops.

Decodes the metadata's gpsFixTimes (polyline value encoding: the first fix's time in tenths of a second since the reference date, then deltas) into one Date per fix; nil when count is 0, there are none, the bytes are not UTF-8, a value is truncated, the running sum overflows, or their number is not `count`.
units.entry: Called by the GPX and TCX exporters; tests call it directly.

branches.cond: count 0, no stored times, or not UTF-8
number of times differs from count

units.does: The track with each fix's timestamp replaced by its recorded time (recordedFixTimes) and coordinate, altitude and accuracies kept; the track unchanged when no matching times are stored.
units.entry: Called by the GPX, TCX and CSV exporters; tests call it directly.

units.does: 'Totals: distance …, elevation gain …, duration …' listing only the totals the session recorded (distanceLabel, elevationLabel, CoachReportGenerator.formatDuration h:mm:ss / m:ss); a nil one is left out rather than written as a measured zero; nil when none was recorded.
Formats metres as '%.2f mi' or '%.2f km' (POSIX format, not app locale).
Formats elevation as '%.0f ft' (×feetPerMeter) or '%.0f m'.
Returns the GPX XML prologue, <gpx> root with namespaces, <metadata> (escaped name '<sport> — <ISO start>', escaped desc, time) and the opening <trk><name><type><trkseg>.
Emits one <trkpt lat lon> per fix (6dp) with <ele> (1dp) when altitude ≠ 0 or verticalAccuracy ≥ 0, and an ISO <time>.

branches.effect: writes <ele>; decode() gives fixes without a stored altitude verticalAccuracy -1 and altitude 0, so those get no <ele>

units.does: Renders the GPX, names it '<sport>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>.gpx' and writes it to the export folder through ExportFile.write (atomic, complete file protection; the same session's file is overwritten on the next export), logs the byte count and returns the URL; throws an NSError if UTF-8 encoding fails, and rethrows a write failure.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite SharedUserDefaults.appGroup; legacy UserDefaults.standard fallback, migrated on read)

units.does: Renders the GPX in memory and names it '<sport>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>.gpx' (POSIX, Gregorian), returning it as an ExportFile.Pending that is written only when shared; throws an NSError if UTF-8 encoding fails.
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite SharedUserDefaults.appGroup; legacy UserDefaults.standard fallback, migrated on read)

branches.effect: throws NSError (cannot happen for a Swift String); otherwise returns the pending export

units.does: Decodes the stored polyline Data (UTF-8 '<coords>\n<altitudes>') to CLLocations with horizontal accuracy 10 m, the stored altitude with vertical accuracy 10 m (or altitude 0 with vertical accuracy -1, CoreLocation's 'altitude invalid', when the fix has no stored altitude), and timestamps startDate + idx×interval, where interval spreads fixes over duration (or 5 s when duration missing).

branches.cond: polyline Data is not valid UTF-8

branches.effect: never nil: split(maxSplits:1, omittingEmptySubsequences:false) always yields at least one element, so the ?? "" fallback is unreachable; an empty first part decodes to no coordinates
altitudes = [] so every fix gets altitude 0 with verticalAccuracy -1

units.does: Seconds between reconstructed fixes: duration/(n−1) when duration>0 and n>1, else 5.
Decodes a Google-polyline coordinate string (1e5 precision, delta-encoded lat/lon pairs).

branches.effect: decode another lat/lon pair; else return

only on a non-ASCII char: stop. If the string ends right after a latitude value, decodeValue does not enter its loop and returns 0, so a point with an unchanged longitude is appended instead of the half pair being dropped

units.does: Decodes the altitude polyline (delta-encoded decimetres → metres).
Decodes one zig-zag varint polyline value (5-bit chunks offset by 63) and advances the index; nil on a non-ASCII char or when the string ends before the value's terminating chunk (a truncated value).

branches.cond: loop ended without a terminating chunk
